Mark-10 R06 Wire Crimp Pull Sensor
Capacity: 200 lbf
 Categories: Mark-10, Wire Pull Test Equipment Tags: 200 lbf capacity, Mark-10, MR06, pull force, Wire crimp pull sensor
Product Description & Resources
 Description 
Description
The MR06 -200 wire crimp pull sensor is a hand-operated solution for measuring wire crimp pull-off forces. The ergonomic handles and convenient tensioning mechanism make field measurements a breeze for applications up to 200 lbF (1,000 N). Squeeze the handles together to increase tension on the sample until a break occurs. The peak force is recorded by a Mark-10 indicator. A rotating turret with slots of multiple sizes accommodates a wide range of wire diameters, up to 0.25 in. (6.4 mm).
*Compatible with a Mark-10 indicator, sold separate.
Features:
MR06 is a member of the Plug and Test family of interchange able sensors and indicators
Ergonomic handles and convenient tensioning mechanism
Measures pull forces
NIST-traceable certificate of calibration with data is included.
CSC Force Measurement can supply an ISO17025 calibration cert with purchase (requires indicator)
Warranty: 3 years
Specifications:
Accuracy: ± 0.5% of full scale + indicator
Weight: 2.5 lb
Slot dimensions (in [mm]): 0.03 [0.8], 0.05 [1.3], 0.06 [1.5], 0.08 [2.0], 0.09 [2.3], 0.11 [2.8], 0.13 [3.3], 0.14 [3.6], 0.16 [4.1], 0.17 [4.3], 0.19 [4.8], 0.20 [5.1], 0.22 [5.6], 0.24 [6.1], 0.25 [6.4]
Minimum sample length: 7.0 in [178 mm]

The Mark-10 G1071 Score Bending Fixture Set
Capacity: 50 lbf
 Categories: Gripping Fixtures, Mark-10 Tags: G1071, Mark-10, Score Bend Fixture, TAPPI T829
Product Description & Resources
 Description 
Description
This set of fixtures is used to produce a 90° bend in fiber board materials and plastics. The fixtures are compliant to TAPPI standard T829 for evaluating the relative quality of scores in corrugated containers.
Upper and lower fixtures are easily removable.
Use this fixture with a choice of test stand and force gauge to create a complete score bend testing system.
Note: These fixtures are designed for compatibility with a Mark-10 force gauge and test stand. The resulting value displayed on the force gauge will be a force value. The abstract score ratio as called for in T829 is not automatically calculated.
Features and Specifications:
Set of upper and lower dies produce 90° bend in corrugated board and plastics
Meets the requirements of TAPPI T829
Fixtures are easily removable
Maximum force: 50 lbF (250 N)
Mounts directly to the following test stands (Motorized test frames recommended)
F105, F305, F505, F755, and F1505 Test Frames
ESM303, ESM750, ESM1500, ES30, TSC1000, TSF  Test Stands
ES10/ES20 (when ordered with optional AC1060 mounting plate).
A motorized test stand is required to fufill the test speed requirement of TAPPI T829.
Weight:
Upper die: 0.2 lb [0.1 kg]
Lower die: 0.3 lb [0.1 kg]
Included items:
Upper die includes a 5/16-18M to #10-32F thread adapter and #10-32 M/M stud with jam nuts.
Lower die includes mounting hardware for above listed test stands.

Mark-10 EKM5-200 Myometer Kit
Capacity: 200 lbF
 Categories: Dynamometer Medical & Ergonomics Testing, Mark-10 Tags: 200 lb, ergonomics gauge, Mark-10, Myometer Kit, Pull
Product Description & Resources
 Description 
Description
The Model EKM5-200 Myometer Kit facilitates a wide range of strength assessments and ergonomics studies. Featuring a Series 5 force gauge with 200 lbF (1,000 N) range, tabletop mount, strap, and accessories, this kit is ideal for ergonomists and other
Features
Measures real time, average, and peak pull and push forces
200 lbf force capacity
Accuracy of ±0.1% of full scale
Sampling rate of 7,000 Hz
UBS, RS-232 and analog outputs
High/low limit indicators, for pass / fail and minimum force testing
1,000- point data memory with statistical calculations. Data may be bulk downloaded to included MESUR® lite data collection software.
Force Gauge is compatible with other Mark-10 grips and attachments
Specifications:
Accuracy:
±0.1% of full scale
Sampling Rate:
7,000 Hz
Power:
AC or rechargeable battery. Multi-step low battery indicator is displayed, gauge shuts off automatically when power is too low.
Battery Life:
Backlight on: Up to 7 hours of continuous use
Backlight off: Up to 24 hours of continuous use
Capacity x Resolution:
200 x 0.05 lbF
3200 x 1 ozF
100 x 0.02 kgf
1000 x 0.2 N
1 x 0.0002 kN
Outputs:
USB / RS-232: configurable up to 115,200 baud. Automatic output available to 250 Hz. Includes Gauge Control Language 2 for full computer control
Analog: ± 1 VDC, ±0.25% of full scale at capacity
General purpose: Three open drain outputs, one input
Set points: Three open drain lines
Safe Overload:
200% of full scale (display shows “over” at 110% and above)
Warranty
3 years
Included Items:
M5-200 Advanced force gauge
Carrying case
Tabletop mounting kit for force gauge, for vertical or horizontal orientation
Adjustable length looped strap
G1107 snap hoop
AC charger
MESUR Lite data collection software
USB cable
NIST-traceable certificate of calibration
CSC can provide an ISO17025 with purchase
Additional items to consider
Mesur gauge Plus software
P/N: 15-1005

Mark-10 G1074 Standard Vice Grip
Capacity: 500 lbf
 Categories: Gripping Fixtures, Mark-10 Tags: 500 lbf, G1074, Mark-10, Vise Grip
Product Description & Resources
 Description 
Description
This general purpose vise can be used in a wide range of tension and compression testing applications. Wide opening range accommodates large and unique samples. Rugged design permits testing up to 500 lbF (2,500 N).
The G1106 self-centering vise grip offers smooth removable jaws can be field-modified to improve sample gripping characteristics as required for pull testing applications.

For general tension and compression testing applications

F105, F305,F505,F755, F1505
ESM303, ESM750, ESM1500, ES30, TSC1000, TSF.
Also compatible with ES10/ES20 when ordered with optional AC1060 mounting plate
